sourceLearning.unavailable.source: The source outcome record is unavailable. No empty or zero-value record is inferred.

sourceLearning.boundary.source: This record counts independently classified and funded outside runs. Source owners, known beneficiaries, unknown history and private jobs cannot improve the estimate. Live learned selection is withheld until the policy and authority checks are accepted.

sourceLearning.window.source: Sample: up to {scan} recent public runs and {sample} eligible observations per source/topic; one attested actor per UTC day. Excluded observations: {excluded}. Historical runs without the required record: {historical}.

sourceLearning.empty.source: No eligible source/topic observations are recorded in this window. This does not establish poor source value.

sourceLearning.price.text: 访问成本 / 购买次数

sourceLearning.meaning.source: Bought counts source/run observations, not articles. The estimate uses Beta(1,1) smoothing; ± is a descriptive uncertainty proxy, not a confidence interval or factual accuracy score. Access cost divided by purchases retains an exact rational mean. Settlement is recorded evidence, not a new Circle or chain verification.
sourceLearning.meaning.text: 购买数统计来源/运行观察，不是文章数。估值使用 Beta(1,1) 平滑；± 是描述性不确定性近似量，不是置信区间或事实准确性评分。访问成本除以购买次数保留精确有理数均值。结算是已记录证据，不是新的 Circle 或链上核验。

sourceLearning.exploration.source: Live exploration allowance: 0% (0 USDC). A tested prospective planner has an explicit bounded partition; it is not active for your budget.
sourceLearning.exploration.text: 实时探索额度：0%（0 USDC）。已测试的前瞻规划器具有明确受限的分区；尚未用于您的预算。

sourceLearning.change.source: A useful record requires independent eligible purchases followed by citations to retained evidence. In the prospective planner, fewer than five purchases leave value unchanged, later adjustments are limited to ±0.1, and abrupt shifts halve that adjustment. Price, payee and budget rules still govern every purchase.
sourceLearning.change.text: 有用记录需要独立合格购买及随后对保留证据的引用。在前瞻规划器中，少于五次购买不改变价值；之后调整限于 ±0.1，突变时调整减半。每次购买仍遵循价格、收款人及预算规则。

creatorGateway.title.text: 服务器报告的 Circle 余额

creatorGateway.explanation.source: Citation payouts settle inside Circle’s Gateway, so they carry a Circle transfer id instead of a block-explorer hash. Rather than ask you to take our ledger’s word, Keryx checks it hourly against Circle’s public balance API — and you can run the same request yourself:
creatorGateway.explanation.text: 引用付款在 Circle Gateway 内结算，因此带有 Circle 转账 ID 而非区块浏览器哈希。Keryx 每小时通过 Circle 公开余额 API 核对账本，您也可自行执行同一请求：

creatorGateway.boundary.source: A balance above the claim is your own money — deposits, or payouts from any other x402 service that pays this wallet. If you have already cashed out, the money shows in your own wallet on-chain instead and the row reads “cashed out”. Keryx only flags a balance that neither the Gateway nor your wallet accounts for.
creatorGateway.boundary.text: 高于申报额的余额是您自己的资金，来自存款或其他向此钱包付款的 x402 服务。若已提现，资金会出现在您的链上钱包，行状态显示“已提现”。Keryx 仅标记 Gateway 与钱包均无法解释的余额。

creatorPortfolio.emailTitle.text: 引用邮件提醒 — 全部来源

creatorPortfolio.emailDescription.source: One address, every source: get a short email whenever any of your sources is cited and paid. At most one mail per source per hour. Per-source tweaks live on each source's page below.
creatorPortfolio.emailDescription.text: 一个地址覆盖所有来源：任何来源被引用且付款后即收到简短邮件。每个来源每小时最多一封。各来源设置在下方对应页面。

creatorPortfolio.deliveryHeld.source: Addresses are saved, but this deployment hasn't enabled an email provider yet — delivery starts the moment it does.
creatorPortfolio.deliveryHeld.text: 地址已保存，但此部署尚未启用邮件服务商；启用后即开始发送。

creatorDecisions.title.source: How the agent decides on this source
creatorDecisions.title.text: 智能体如何对此来源作出决定

creatorDecisions.paymentBoundary.source: Decision and answer citation counts do not prove paid reads or settled citation rewards. Check earnings and payment evidence separately.
creatorDecisions.paymentBoundary.text: 决策和答案引用次数不能证明付费阅读或已结算引用奖励。请分别查看收益和付款证据。

creatorDecisions.recent.source: Most recent passes, in the agent's words
creatorDecisions.recent.text: 智能体说明的最近跳过原因

creatorDecisions.window.one.source: Every dispatch weighs this source against the others and records its BUY, CACHE or SKIP decisions. Across the last {window} dispatches, {considered} of them weighed this one.
creatorDecisions.window.one.text: 每次研究都会将此来源与其他来源比较，并记录 BUY、CACHE 或 SKIP 决策。最近 {window} 次研究中，有 {considered} 次考虑了此来源。

creatorDecisions.window.other.source: Every dispatch weighs this source against the others and records its BUY, CACHE or SKIP decisions. Across the last {window} dispatches, {considered} of them weighed this one.
creatorDecisions.window.other.text: 每次研究都会将此来源与其他来源比较，并记录 BUY、CACHE 或 SKIP 决策。最近 {window} 次研究中，有 {considered} 次考虑了此来源。

creatorDecisions.priceComparison.source: In the dispatches that passed on it, the sources the agent did choose were listed at a median {rivalPrice} per read. This one asks {price}.
creatorDecisions.priceComparison.text: 跳过此来源的研究中，代理所选来源的每次阅读价格中位数为 {rivalPrice}。此来源报价 {price}。

creatorDecisions.ratedComparison.source: In the dispatches that passed on it, the sources the agent did choose were listed at a median {rivalPrice} per read. This one asks {price}. It rated this source {chosenValue} when it chose to read and {skippedValue} when it passed, on its 0–1 expected-value scale.
creatorDecisions.ratedComparison.text: 跳过此来源的研究中，代理所选来源的每次阅读价格中位数为 {rivalPrice}。此来源报价 {price}。在 0–1 预期价值尺度上，选择阅读时评分为 {chosenValue}，跳过时为 {skippedValue}。

creatorDecisions.skipWithRival.text: 预期价值 {value} · 报价 ${price} · 改选 ${rivalPrice} · {date}
